meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把原始数据按 Setup→Conflict→Resolution 的结构整理成叙事,产出带可视化图表和业务上下文的洞察报告,面向高管、投资者等非技术读者给出结论与建议。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或投资者演示,需要把数据讲成故事时触发。

say.text: 把这份季度数据做成一页高管摘要,先讲关键洞察
say.note: 先给结论,再附数据与影响

say.text: 帮我把 EMEA 和 APAC 的市场数据讲成对比故事
say.note: 会输出对比分析加推荐方案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns raw data into a Setup → Conflict → Resolution narrative, producing insight reports that pair visuals with business context for non-technical readers.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to executives, building quarterly business reviews or investor decks, and you need to turn data into a narrative.

say_en.text: Turn my churn data into a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative
say_en.note: Produces a report with key insight and recommendations

say_en.text: Make this quarter's numbers a one-page exec summary, insight first
say_en.note: Leads with the conclusion, then data and impact

say_en.text: Tell the EMEA vs APAC market data as a comparison story
say_en.note: Outputs side-by-side analysis plus a recommendation
